mcqs.question: According to the ECMWF forecast, when is the Super El Niño expected to begin and how long is it likely to last in 2026?
options: June–August, lasting until the end of the year
May–July, lasting until the end of the year
January–March, lasting until the end of the year
mcqs.explanation: The ECMWF forecast indicates that the Super El Niño is likely to begin during June–August 2026 and continue until the end of the year. The tempting alternative of May–July changes the forecast beginning period.
